title: lab 104 - 2026
description: AWS IAM Users, Groups, and Policies

objectives: Create and manage IAM users and groups.
Assign permissions using AWS managed policies.
Apply the Principle of Least Privilege.
Differentiate between Full Access, Read-only, and Service-specific policies.
Understand why permissions should be managed through groups rather than individual users.
Interpret effective permissions when users belong to multiple groups.

tasks.title: Create Support Team Group
steps: Create a new group named Support Team
Attach AmazonEC2ReadOnlyAccess policy to Support Team group
Assign user support1 to Support Team group

challenges.title: Developer User Access
challenges.requirement: Without creating a new policy, create user developer1
challenges.hint: Use an existing AWS managed policy.

challenges.title: Intern User Access
challenges.requirement: Without creating a new policy, create user intern1

challenges.title: Backup Administrator Access
challenges.requirement: Without creating a new policy, create user backupadmin1
